'''Assassin probes''' were [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]] used during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. They resembled large [[Spider/Legends|spiders]] with eight spindly legs and multiple [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptors]].

==History==
[[File:Assassin_probe.jpg|thumb|left|250px|An assassin probe attacks Duchess Satine's dinner party.]]
Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], three of these [[Droid/Legends|droids]] were used to attack the [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] aboard the [[Coronet/Legends|''Coronet'']]. They were smuggled aboard by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Tal Merrik/Legends|Tal Merrik]]. During that incident, two of the droids attacked and killed the two clones guarding the cargo bay while the third remained hidden. One attempted to deceive [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Skywalker]] by hiding behind the dead body of [[Redeye/Legends|Redeye]], but was discovered and had two of its legs sliced off, then was shot repeatedly by clone troopers. The second droid escaped up the [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] shaft and was dispatched by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. Both droids, after being destroyed, launched dozens of small [[Probe killer/Legends|probe killer]] droids through pits on their heads. The third droid released the probe killer droids while still hidden, then attacked [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]], but was dispatched after Skywalker cut off its legs with a [[Telekinesis/Legends|lightsaber throw]] and Rex had unloaded several [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] rounds into the pits on its head.
